summary: Preview-only test of P1-P4. P1 admin security PASS: admin@kapitalmitte.com/admin123 and patron/500Euro! get 401, QA admin logs in (200, httpOnly cookies, bcrypt $2b$, /admin console loads), change-password with admin1234/changeme/short gets 400 '...mindestens 12 Zeichen...' and the QA password was not changed, 5 wrong logins then the 6th returns 429. P2 contact PASS: one real send returned 200 {accepted:true, status:handed_to_provider} and showed the success toast; the form was cleared. A mocked 502 shows the error toast with the backend detail, no success toast, and the form keeps its values. A mocked 200 {accepted:false} shows an error. An invalid email is blocked by native validation and sends no request. P3 PASS: /dashboard/ipo has 15 cards and exactly 1 OpenAI card, and the IPO detail dialog opens. P4 stock PASS: DBK tiles Eröffnung 29,86 / Hoch 30,41 / Tief 29,48 / Vortag 28,95 / Volumen 4.273.102 are all filled. DBK 1T axis 10:00-15:00, with the first point at 08:00 UTC = 09:00 CET. AAPL 1T axis starts 14:30 Berlin, which is correct this week: EU is already on CET (since Oct 25) and US is still on EDT until Nov 1, so 13:30 UTC = 14:30 Berlin. All 7 ranges render. No horizontal overflow on mobile at 390px. P4 Aufträge PARTIAL: the tester account has no orders, so the timeline was checked with mocked API responses. cancelled -> Storniert, pending -> Ausstehend and executed -> Ausgeführt work. But real DB values 'completed' (stock_orders) and cash ledger types 'stock_purchase', 'stock_sale', 'bond_purchase', 'ipo_purchase' show as raw English/snake_case words. Regression: home, login, admin console OK.

minor.issue: Lockout is keyed by email only. Anyone can lock any account (including admins) for 15 min by sending 5 wrong passwords. After locked_until expires the count stays >=5, so one more failure locks again right away (count is only reset by a successful login). Consider a combined IP+email key or resetting the count when the lock expires.

Only checks 7 hard-coded passwords. Other entries in WEAK_PASSWORDS (test1234, 12345678, qwerty123...) and existing admin passwords shorter than 12 chars are not disabled. The comment in the ADMIN_EXTRAS block still says it 'aktualisiert Passwort-Hash', but the code no longer does.
If the provider answers 2xx without an 'id', this is treated as send_failed and returns 502, even though the mail may have been delivered. Edge case only; the current provider does return an id.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing German labels. stock_orders status 'completed' (exists in DB) shows as 'completed'. cash_ledger types stock_purchase, stock_sale, bond_purchase, ipo_purchase show raw (seen in UI with mocked /api/portfolio/cash). Add e.g. completed:'Abgeschlossen', stock_purchase:'Aktienkauf', stock_sale:'Aktienverkauf', bond_purchase:'Anleihekauf', ipo_purchase:'IPO-Kauf'. Also the Aktien-Aufträge table shows a 'completed' order as 'AUSSTEHEND', which does not match the timeline.

issues: Header change shows +3,25%, but price 29,82 vs Vortag 28,95 is only +3,0%. The quote's prev_close comes from a different source than the intraday prior-day last 5-min close. Small inconsistency, informational only.
